original.target_description: Study 6: indirect effect of hierarchy condition (high = 1, low = 0), through corruption perceptions, on beliefs that the anti-corruption petition/audit was justified; PROCESS Model 4, 5000 bootstrap samples.

n.sample_role: Participants; model-specific analytic sample size not explicitly reported. Study 6 final sample was 97 farmer’s-market attendees; Table 2 labels condition samples n = 47 and n = 50 but does not explicitly establish complete cases in the mediation model.
n.exclusions: Six of 103 participants excluded from all analyses for awareness of deception; model-specific missingness/exclusions not documented.
